title: TradeInSubmitResponse
description: Outcome of a trade-in submission, shared by MCP, A2A and PAP. valued carries a valuation with an amount, a range or both. received means the dealer accepted the description and will respond later; it requires consented contact data. rejected means nothing was recorded. A valuation is an estimate unless kind is offer; even an offer depends on the vehicle matching its description at inspection. Retries replay the complete original result with data.replayed true.

trade_in_id.description: Dealer-assigned identifier for this trade-in submission.

status.description: valued: a valuation is included. received: accepted for dealer follow-up without an immediate valuation. rejected: not accepted; nothing was recorded. An idempotent replay preserves this value.

valuation.description: Present iff status is valued. Carries amount, the amount_min/amount_max range, or both.

amount.description: Single headline value in whole units of currency.

amount_min.description: Lower bound of the valuation range in whole units of currency. Present only together with amount_max.

amount_max.description: Upper bound of the valuation range in whole units of currency. Present only together with amount_min.

currency.description: Currency of every valuation amount. Omitted means USD.

kind.description: estimate: non-binding indication. offer: the dealer commits to the valuation until expires_at if the vehicle matches its description at inspection. Omitted means estimate.

expires_at.description: Last moment the valuation stands, as an ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp with timezone offset. Required when kind is offer.

source.description: Valuation provider or method, such as a named guide book or the dealer's appraisal desk.

disclaimer.description: Conditions the customer must see with the valuation, such as inspection or title requirements.

dealer.description: Convenience contact summary for the buyer agent to surface follow-up details to the user.

phone.description: E.164 phone number for buyer follow-up.

replayed.description: True on an idempotent replay. Every other response field repeats the original result, including the valuation. False or absent on the original result.

message.description: Contextual note from the dealer, such as how to book an inspection.
